deficiency.overview: Deficiency is very rare in the United States; rare inherited disorders can affect utilization. Symptoms cannot diagnose it.
deficiency.medicalBoundary: Symptoms are nonspecific and cannot diagnose a nutrient deficiency. Diagnosis may require clinical evaluation and appropriate laboratory testing.

excess.overview: Very high supplemental amounts can cause gastrointestinal upset and diarrhea. This page gives no dosing prescription.
excess.medicalBoundary: No upper limit is an intake goal. Seek professional or medical advice before changing supplement or medication use.
